title: A Fenchel-type inequality for the Kullback–Leibler function
statement:
For every real number $u \ge 0$ and every real number $y$,
\[
u\,y \;\le\; \left(u\ln u - u + 1\right) + e^{y} - 1,
\]
where the term $u\ln u$ is taken to be $0$ at $u = 0$.
hypotheses_covered: u is a real number with 0 ≤ u
y is an arbitrary real number
replaced:
For real numbers $u \ge 0$ and $y$, one has $u \cdot y \le \mathrm{klFun}(u) + e^y - 1$,
where $\mathrm{klFun}(u) = u \ln u - u + 1$.
